species.name: Cabai Bunga-Api
species.summary: Cabai bunga-api adalah spesies burung yang mempunyai warna oranye kekuningan dan bagian sayap serta kepala berwarna abu - abu kehitaman. Makananya buah - buahan seperti pepaya, pisang, benalu, kersen/ talok dsb. Dan juga memakan serangga kecil seperti ulat, kroto, ngengat, belalang kecil, dsb.

species.name: Bubut besar
species.summary: Bubut besar (bahasa Latin = Centropus sinensis) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Cuculidae, dari genus ]. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan ulat, belalang, kumbang, hemiptera, katak, kadal yang memiliki habitat di tepi hutan, belukar sekunder, semak tepi sungai, hutan mangrove.

species.name: Raja-Udang Meninting
species.summary: Raja-udang Meninting (Alcedo meninting) berasal dari Asia, tersebar melewati Subkontinen India dan Asia Tenggara. Persebarannya dari barat India, ke arah timur Nepal, Bhutan dan Bangladesh, menuju ke Myanmar, Thailand, Kamboja, Vietnam dan Malaysia.

species.name: Cikrak Daun
species.summary: Cikrak daun (bahasa Latin: Phylloscopus trivirgatus) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Sylviidae, dari genus Phylloscopus. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan ulat kupu, kumbang kecil, lebah, semu dan memiliki habitat di hutan gunung, perbukitan, tepi hutan, zona alpin, tersebar pada ketinggian 800-3.000 m dpl.

species.name: Capung-Sambar Hijau
species.summary: Orthetrum sabina, the slender skimmer or green marsh hawk, is a species of dragonfly in the family Libellulidae. It is widespread, being found from south-eastern Europe and North Africa to Japan and south to Australia and Micronesia. Adults are grayish to greenish yellow with black and pale markings.

species.name: Bangkong Kolong
species.summary: Bangkong kolong atau kodok rumah memiliki nama ilmiah Bufo melanostictus Schneider. Kodok ini juga dikenal dengan beberapa nama lain seperti kodok buduk (Btw.), kodok berut/kerok, kodok kintêl (Jw.), kodok brama (Jw., yang berwarna kemerahan), dan Asian black-spined toad (Ingg.).

species.name: Cabak Maling
species.summary: Cabak maling (bahasa Latin = Caprimulgus macrurus) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Caprimulgidae, dari genus Caprimulgus.

species.name: Sepah Kecil
species.summary: Sepah kecil (bahasa Latin: Pericrocotus cinnamomeus) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Campephagidae, dari genus Pericrocotus. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan ulat kupu, laba-laba, tempayak, serangga lai yang memiliki habitat di dataran rendah, hutan sekunder, hutan mangrove, perkebunan, tegalan.

species.name: Dara laut kecil
species.summary: Dara-laut kecil (Sternula albifrons) atau (Sterna albifrons) adalah Burung laut yang berfamilia Sternidae atau dalam Bahasa Indonesianya, Dara laut. Dari awalnya, burung ini diletakkan pada genus Sterna, di mana sekarang ini terbatas pada jenis ukuran dara-laut putih besar (Bridge et al., 2005).

species.name: Cerek Kernyut
species.summary: The Pacific golden plover (Pluvialis fulva) is a medium-sized plover. The genus name is Latin and means relating to rain, from pluvia, "rain". It was believed that golden plovers flocked when rain was imminent. The species name fulva is Latin and refers to a tawny colour.

species.name: Pijantung Kecil
species.summary: Pijantung kecil (bahasa Latin: Arachnothera longirostra) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Nectariniidae, dari genus Arachnothera.

species.name: Dara laut tengkuk-hitam
species.summary: The black-naped tern (Sterna sumatrana) is an oceanic tern mostly found in tropical and subtropical areas of the Pacific and Indian Oceans. It is rarely found inland.

species.name: Cinenen Kelabu
species.summary: Cinenen kelabu (Orthotomus ruficeps) adalah jenis burung pengicau dengan panjang tubuh 10–12 cm. Burung ini, terutama dalam perdagangan, dikenal juga dengan nama prenjak. Namanya dalam bahasa Inggris ialah Ashy tailorbird.

species.name: Cangak Abu
species.summary: Cangak Abu atau dalam nama ilmiahnya Ardea cinerea merupakan salah satu jenis burung Kuntul.

species.name: Gagang-Bayam Timur
species.summary: Gagang-bayam timur (bahasa Latin = Himantopus leucocephalus) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Recurvirostridae, dari genus Himantopus. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan invertebrata kecil yang memiliki habitat di rawa payau, rawa tawar, danau dangkal, tepi sungai, sawah, beting lumpur, tambak garam.

species.name: Kangkok Sunda
species.summary: The Sunda cuckoo or Sunda lesser cuckoo (Cuculus lepidus) is a South-east Asian bird belonging to the genus Cuculus in the cuckoo family, Cuculidae. It was formerly classified with the Himalayan cuckoo (C. saturatus) and Oriental cuckoo (C. optatus) in a single species, C.

species.name: Sikatan Ninon
species.summary: Sikatan ninon (bahasa Latin: Eumyias indigo) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Muscicapidae, dari genus Eumyias. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan kumbang, larva kunang-kunang, serangga lain, buah keci dan memiliki habitat di hutan gelap pegunungan, tersebar pada ketinggian 900-3.000 m dpl.

species.name: Dara laut biasa
species.summary: Dara-laut Biasa (Sterna hirundo) adalah burung laut dari famili Dara laut Sternidae.

species.name: Cecak tembok
species.summary: Hemidactylus platyurus, commonly known as the flat-tailed house gecko, is a species of Gekkonidae native to southeastern and southern Asia. The species is sometimes classified under the genus Cosymbotus.

species.name: Sikepmadu asia
species.summary: Sikep-madu asia (Pernis ptilorhynchus) adalah spesies burung pemangsa dalam famili Accipitridae. Burung ini tersebar di Palearktika timur, India, dan Asia Tenggara sampai Sunda Besar.

species.name: Pecukular asia
species.summary: Pecuk-ular asia (bahasa Latin = Anhinga melanogaster) adalah salah satu spesies burung Pecuk ular. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan ikan yang memiliki habitat di pada genangan air luas, danau, sungai besar. tersebar sampai ketinggian 1.400 m dpl.

species.name: Bengkarung
species.summary: Kadal kebun alias bengkarung biasa adalah sejenis reptil berkaki empat anggota suku Scincidae (kadal sejati). Disebut kadal kebun, karena bengkarung biasa dijumpai di kebun pekarangan.

species.name: Kapasan Kemiri
species.summary: Kapasan kemiri (bahasa Latin: Lalage nigra) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Campephagidae, dari genus Lalage. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan serangg yang memiliki habitat di lahan pertanian, dataran rendah terbuka, hutan sekunder, hutan mangrove, tersebar sampai ketinggian 1.000 m dpl.

species.name: Srigunting Batu
species.summary: The greater racket-tailed drongo (Dicrurus paradiseus) is a medium-sized Asian bird which is distinctive in having elongated outer tail feathers with webbing restricted to the tips. They are placed along with other drongos in the family Dicruridae.

species.name: Cekakak Belukar
species.summary: Cekakak belukar:226 atau cekakak dada-putih:225 (Halcyon smyrnensis) adalah sejenis burung raja-udang dari suku Halcyonidae (dahulu, Alcedinidae).

species.name: Raja-Udang Erasia
species.summary: Raja-udang eurasia (Alcedo atthis) juga diketahui sebagai Raja-udang biasa atau Raja-udang sungai, adalah raja-udang kecil dengan tujuh subspesies yang diakui dalam distribusi yang luas di seluruh Eurasia dan Afrika Utara.

species.name: Trinil Ekor-Kelabu
species.summary: The grey-tailed tattler or Polynesian tattler, Tringa brevipes (formerly Heteroscelus brevipes) is a small, foraging shorebird in the genus Tringa. The English name for the tattlers refers to their noisy call.

species.name: Trinil Kaki-Hijau
species.summary: Trinil kaki-hijau (bahasa Latin = Tringa nebularia) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Scolopacidae, dari genus Tringa. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan ikan, berudu, krustasea, cacing, larva serangga yang memiliki habitat di rawa, gosong lumpur, tambak.

species.name: Elang tiram
species.summary: Elang tiram atau Elang ikan, yang dalam nama ilmiahnya Pandion haliaetus adalah salah satu-satunya spesies dalam suku Pandionidae dan genus Pandion.

species.name: Angsabatu coklat
species.summary: The brown booby (Sula leucogaster) is a large seabird of the booby family, Sulidae. They present sexual dimorphism. The female booby reaches about 80 centimetres (31 in) in length, its wingspan measures up to 150 cm (4.9 ft), and they can weigh up to 1,300 g (2.9 lb).

species.name: Ayam hutan merah
species.summary: Ayam hutan merah atau dalam nama ilmiahnya Gallus gallus adalah sejenis burung berukuran sedang, dengan panjang sekitar 78 cm, dari suku Phasianidae. Ayam betina berukuran lebih kecil, dengan panjang sekitar 46 cm.

species.name: Kutilang
species.summary: Ketilang, burung nilam, atau cucak kutilang adalah sejenis burung pengicau dari suku Pycnonotidae. Orang Sunda menyebutnya cangkurileung, orang Jawa menamainya ketilang atau genthilang, mengikuti bunyi suaranya yang khas.

species.name: Katak-Pohon Bergaris
species.summary: Katak-pohon bergaris adalah nama sejenis kodok yang biasa hidup di pohon. Kodok ini juga disebut dalam beberapa bahasa daerah sebagai gedindang atau cekay (Sd.), perkak (Bms.), bencok (Jw.), dan lain-lain.

species.name: Sikatan Burik
species.summary: The grey-streaked flycatcher or grey-spotted flycatcher (Muscicapa griseisticta) is a small passerine bird of eastern Asia belonging to the genus Muscicapa in the Old World flycatcher family Muscicapidae.

species.name: Apung Sawah
species.summary: The paddyfield pipit, or Oriental pipit, (Anthus rufulus) is a small passerine bird in the pipit and wagtail family. It is a resident (non-migratory) breeder in open scrub, grassland and cultivation in southern Asia east to the Philippines.

species.name: Mandar Batu
species.summary: Mandar batu (bahasa Latin = Gallinula chloropus) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Rallidae, dari genus Gallinula. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan serangga air, binatang kecil, pucuk tanaman muda yang memiliki habitat di danau, kolam, parit, sawah, tambak payau, tersebar sampai ketinggian 1.200 m dpl.

species.name: Tikusan Alis-Putih
species.summary: The white-browed crake (Poliolimnas cinereus) is a species of bird in the family Rallidae. It is found in Australia, Brunei, Cambodia, Fiji, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Japan, India, Malaysia, Micronesia, New Caledonia, Palau, Papua New Guinea, the Philippines, Samoa, Singapore, Solomon Islands, Thailand, and Vanuatu.

species.name: Kedasi Laut
species.summary: The little bronze cuckoo (Chrysococcyx minutillus) is a species of cuckoo in the family Cuculidae. It is found in Southeast Asia, New Guinea and northern and eastern Australia. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests. This is the world's smallest cuckoo, at 17 grams and 15 cm (6 in).

species.name: Cangak laut
species.summary: Cangak laut merupakan jenis burung Kuntul yang hidup di tepian pantai. Sebarannya terletak di Sumatra, Pulau Jawa, Pulau Bali, Kalimantan, sampai Australia. Burung ini berukuran besar, yakni berukuran 115 cm. Irisnya berwarna abu-abu gelap (abu-abu kecoklatan). Cangak laut beruban dan berjambul pendek.

species.name: Kicuit Kerbau
species.summary: The eastern yellow wagtail (Motacilla tschutschensis) is a small passerine in the wagtail family Motacillidae, which also includes the pipits and longclaws. It was often classified as a subspecies of the Western yellow wagtail.

species.name: Seriwang timur
species.summary: Blyth's paradise flycatcher (Terpsiphone affinis) also called the oriental paradise flycatcher, is a species of bird in the family Monarchidae. It is found from southern China to Sumatra and Melanesia.

species.name: Pekaka Emas
species.summary: Pekaka emas adalah spesies burung yang mempunyai paruh, berdarah panas, dan membiak dengan cara bertelur.

species.name: Burung madu sepah-raja
species.summary: Burung-madu sepah-raja (bahasa Latin: Aethopyga siparaja) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Nectariniidae, dari genus Aethopyga. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan nektar, serangg dan memiliki habitat di semak, perkebunan, hutan. tersebar sampai ketinggian 800–900 m dpl.

Nephila pilipes (northern golden orb weaver or giant golden orb weaver) is a species of golden orb-web spider. It can be found in Japan, China, Vietnam, Cambodia, Taiwan, Malaysia, Singapore, Myanmar, Indonesia, Thailand, Laos, Philippines, Sri Lanka, India, Nepal, Papua New Guinea, and Australia.

species.name: Lakirumbai kecil
species.summary: The red-necked phalarope (Phalaropus lobatus) is a small wader. This phalarope breeds in the Arctic regions of North America and Eurasia. It is migratory, and, unusually for a wader, winters at sea on tropical oceans.

species.name: Mandar-Padi Kalung-Kuning
species.summary: The buff-banded rail (Gallirallus philippensis) is a distinctively coloured, highly dispersive, medium-sized rail of the rail family, Rallidae.

species.name: Layang-Layang Batu
species.summary: Layang-layang batu (Hirundo javanica) atau dalam bahasa Inggris dikenal juga sebagai Pacific Swallow adalah spesies burung dalam famili Hirundinidae. Burung ini tersebar luas dari Asia Selatan hingga Asia Tenggara.

species.name: Kepinis Laut
species.summary: Kapinis laut (bahasa Latin = Apus pacificus) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Apodidae, dari genus Apus. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan serangga kecil yang memiliki habitat di daerah terbuka, tersebar sampai ketinggian 1.500 m dpl.

species.name: Dara laut batu
species.summary: The bridled tern (Onychoprion anaethetus) is a seabird of the family Laridae. It is a bird of the tropical oceans. The scientific name is from Ancient Greek. The genus is onux, "claw", and "prion", nail. The specific anaethetus means "senseless, stupid".

species.name: Kedasi hitam
species.summary: Kedasi hitam (bahasa Latin = Surniculus lugubris) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Cuculidae, dari genus Surniculus. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan ulat, laba-laba, kumbang, serangga lain, buah yang memiliki habitat di hutan, tepi hutan, semak belukar, dataran rendah tersebar sampai ketinggian 900 m dpl.

species.name: Belibis Kembang
species.summary: Belibis kembang (Dendrocygna arcuata) adalah spesies burung dalam famili Anatidae. Burung ini tersebar di Filipina, Kalimantan, Sulawesi, Jawa, Nusa Tenggara, Maluku, Papua, Australia, dan Britania Baru.

species.name: Trinil Kaki-Merah
species.summary: Trinil kaki-merah (bahasa Latin = Tringa totanus) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Scolopacidae, dari genus Tringa. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan cacing, moluska, krustasea yang memiliki habitat di beting lumpur, pantai, rawa, tambak kering, sawah dekat laut. Kadang dijumpai jauh di pedalaman.

species.name: Cica-Koreng Jawa
species.summary: Cica-koreng jawa (bahasa Latin: Megalurus palustris) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Locustellidae dari genus Megalurus. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan kumbang, belalang, serangga dan memiliki habitat di lapangan rumput terbuka, rumpun gelagah, bambu, semak sekunder, kebun teh.

species.name: Kangkareng perut-putih
species.summary: Kangkareng perut-putih (Anthracoceros albirostris) adalah spesies burung rangkong dalam famili Bucerotidae. Burung ini tersebar di India, China, Asia Tenggara, Semenanjung Malaysia, dan Sunda Besar.

species.name: Perenjak Rawa
species.summary: Perenjak rawa:358 atau perenjak perut-kuning:323 (Prinia flaviventris) adalah spesies burung dalam famili Cisticolidae. Burung kecil ini tersebar luas mulai dari Pakistan di barat, melalui anak-benua India dan Asia Tenggara hingga ke Cina selatan di timur, serta Sumatra, Kalimantan dan Jawa di selatan.

species.name: Elang brontok
species.summary: Elang brontok adalah sejenis burung pemangsa anggota suku Accipitridae. Dinamai demikian kemungkinan karena warnanya yang berbercak-bercak (pada bentuk yang berwarna terang).

species.name: Merbah Belukar
species.summary: Merbah belukar (Pycnonotus plumosus) adalah nama sejenis burung pengicau dari suku Pycnonotidae. Burung ini juga disebut dengan nama lain: mancrang. Nama ilmiahnya adalah Pycnonotus plumosus Blyth, 1845. Sementara dalam bahasa Inggris disebut Olive-winged Bulbul, sesuai dengan warna sayapnya.

species.name: Merbah Corok-Corok
species.summary: Merbah corok-corok (bahasa Latin: Pycnonotus simplex) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Pycnonotidae, dari genus Pycnonotus. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan buah-buahan kecil, serangga yang memiliki habitat di hutan primer, vegetasi terbuka sekunder, tersebar sampai ketinggian 1.300 mdpl.

species.name: Biawak Air
species.summary: Varanus salvator, atau lazim dikenal sebagai biawak air atau biawak air asia, adalah kadal besar yang endemik di Asia Selatan dan Asia Tenggara.

species.name: Serindit melayu
species.summary: Serindit riau atau dalam nama ilmiahnya Loriculus galgulus adalah sejenis burung yang terdapat di dalam genus burung serindit Loriculus. Burung ini berukuran kecil, dengan panjang mencapai 12 cm. Bulunya didominasi oleh warna hijau dengan bulu ekor berwarna merah.

species.name: Elang tikus
species.summary: Elang tikus (Elanus caeruleus) adalah burung Pemangsa diurnal berukuran kecil dalam familia Accipitridae yang terkenal karena kebiasaannya melayang dalam padang rumput terbuka seperti kebiasaan kestrel yang berukuran kecil.

species.name: Sempur-Hujan Rimba
species.summary: The banded broadbill (Eurylaimus javanicus) is a species of bird in the Eurylaimidae family. It is found in Brunei, Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, Singapore, Thailand, and Vietnam. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests.

species.name: Sikatan-Rimba Dada-Coklat
species.summary: Sikatan-rimba dada-coklat (bahasa Latin: Cyornis olivacea) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Muscicapidae, dari genus Cyornis. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan serangg dan memiliki habitat di tepi hutan, hutan sekunder, perkebunan. tersebar sampai ketinggain 1.200 m dpl.

species.name: Capung-Jala Lurus
species.summary: Neurothemis terminata adalah spesies capung dalam famili Libellulidae. Neurothemis terminata adalah jenis yang umum ditemukan di daerah perkotaan, tersebar luas dari Semenanjung Malaysia, Jepang hingga ke Nusa Tenggara di Indonesia.

species.name: Kirik-Kirik Biru
species.summary: Kirik-kirik biru adalah spesies burung yang mempunyai paruh, berdarah panas, dan membiak dengan cara bertelur.

species.name: Capung-Tengger biru
species.summary: Diplacodes trivialis, is a species of dragonfly in the family Libellulidae, known as the chalky percher or ground skimmer. It is found in China, Japan, India and southwards to New Guinea and Australia.

species.name: Walet-Palem Asia
species.summary: Walet-palem asia (Cypsiurus balasiensis) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Apodidae (burung walet), dari genus Cypsiurus (Walet-palem).

species.name: Alap-alap capung
species.summary: Alap-alap capung (Microhierax fringillarius) adalah burung yang mempunyai paruh kecil, berdarah panas, dan membiak dengan cara bertelur. Alap-alap ini merupakan burung karnivora terkecil di dunia. Alap-alap capung tergolong hewan langka yang dilindungi dan dapat ditemukan di Asia Tenggara.

species.name: Meninting Besar
species.summary: Meninting besar (Enicurus leschenaulti) adalah spesies burung yang termasuk dalam famili Muscicapidae. Burung ini tersebar di Himalaya, Myanmar, China, Thailand, Semenanjung Malaysia, dan Sunda Besar.

species.name: Cikalang besar
species.summary: Cikalang besar (Fregata minor) adalah spesies burung cikalang dalam famili Fregatidae. Burung ini tersebar di lautan tropis, tempat koloni berbiak terdekat adalah Pulau Chrismast di Samudra Hindia, Pulau Manuk, dan Gunung Api di Laut Banda.

species.name: Perenjak Padi
species.summary: Perenjak padi:358 (Prinia inornata) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Cisticolidae. Burung penghuni wilayah rawa-rawa gelagah dan padang rumput tinggi ini dalam bahasa Inggris dikenal sebagai Plain Prinia.
The Moorish idol (Zanclus cornutus), is a marine fish species, the sole extant representative of the family Zanclidae (from the Greek ζαγκίος, zagkios, "oblique") in order Perciformes.

species.name: Pelanduk Topi-Hitam
species.summary: Pelanduk topi-hitam (Pellorneum capistratum) adalah nama sejenis burung dari suku Timaliidae. Nama-nama lainnya di antaranya adalah kancilan (Sd., ada beberapa spesies yang dinamai serupa). Dalam bahasa Inggris, burung ini dikenal sebagai Rufous-browed Babbler, merujuk pada warna hitam di atas kepalanya.

species.name: Kipasan ekor-merah
species.summary: Kipasan ekor-merah (Rhipidura phoenicura) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Rhipiduridae. Burung ini adalah hewan endemik dari Indonesia. Habitat burung kipasan ekor-merah pada ekosistem montana dengan iklim subtropis atau tropis.

species.name: Penyu hijau
species.summary: Penyu hijau (Chelonia mydas) adalah penyu laut besar yang termasuk dalam keluarga Cheloniidae. Hewan ini adalah satu-satunya spesies dalam golongan Chelonia. Mereka hidup di semua laut tropis dan subtropis, terutama di Samudera Atlantik dan Samudera Pasifik.

species.name: Pelatuk besi
species.summary: Pelatuk besi (bahasa Latin: Dinopium javanense) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Picidae, dari genus Dinopium.

species.name: Berencet Berkening
species.summary: The eyebrowed wren-babbler (Napothera epilepidota) is a species of bird in the Pellorneidae family. It is found in Bhutan, China, India, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, Thailand, and Vietnam. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests and subtropical or tropical moist montane forests.

species.name: Kancilan Bakau
species.summary: Kancilan bakau (bahasa Latin: Pachycephala grisola) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Pachycephalidae, dari genus Pachycephala.

species.name: Merbah Mata-Merah
species.summary: The Asian red-eyed bulbul (Pycnonotus brunneus) is a member of the bulbul family of passerine birds. It is found on the Malay Peninsula, Sumatra, and Borneo. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests.

species.name: Gosong pilipina
species.summary: The Philippine megapode (Megapodius cumingii), also known as the Philippine scrubfowl or the Tabon scrubfowl, is a species of bird in the Megapodiidae family. It is found in northeastern Borneo, Sulawesi and the Philippines.

species.name: Daralaut sayap-putih
species.summary: Chlidonias leucopterus adalah spesies dara laut dalam keluarga Laridae. Ini adalah spesies kecil yang umumnya ditemukan di atau dekat perairan air tawar di sebagian besar dunia, termasuk Eropa, Afrika, Asia, dan Australia. Nama genus berasal dari khelidonios Yunani Kuno, "seperti menelan", dari khelidon, "menelan".

species.name: Bentet kelabu
species.summary: Bentet kelabu (bahasa Latin: Lanius schach) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Laniidae, dari genus Lanius. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan belalang, kumbang, tonggeret, serangga besa dan memiliki habitat di daerah terbuka, padang rumput, perkebunan, tegalan. tersebar sampai ketinggian 1.600 m dpl.

images.credit: Alan Kwok (King Lun), Ada Tai (Ah Heung) / 阿達蘭 AdAlan

species.name: Elang paria
species.summary: Elang paria (Milvus migrans) adalah spesies Burung pemangsa dari keluarga Accipitridae. Burung ini dianggap sebagai spesies yang paling melimpah dari keluarga acciptrid, meskipun beberapa jumlah telah mengalami penurunan dramatis.

species.name: Sepah kerdil
species.summary: The little minivet (Pericrocotus lansbergei), also known as the Flores minivet, is a species of bird in the Campephagidae family. It is endemic to Indonesia. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests.

species.name: Cikrak Kutub
species.summary: The Arctic warbler (Phylloscopus borealis) is a widespread leaf warbler in birch or mixed birch forest near water throughout its breeding range in Fennoscandia and northern Asia. It has established a foothold in North America, breeding in Alaska.

species.name: Munguk Beledu
species.summary: Munguk beledu (Sitta frontalis) atau gelatik munguk adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Sittidae, dari genus Sitta.
Giru ekor kuning ( Amphiprion clarkii ), juga dikenal sebagai polimas kuning, adalah ikan laut milik keluarga Pomacentridae, ikan badut dan ikan betok hias .
The Sunburst Butterflyfish, Chaetodon kleinii, is also known as the Black-lipped Butterflyfish (or "blacklip butterflyfish") or Klein's Butterflyfish.

species.name: Capung Sambar Jingga
species.summary: Orthetrum testaceum is an Asian freshwater dragonfly species. It is distributed throughout India, Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Singapore and Thailand. One subspecies has been described, Orthetrum testaceum soembanum.

species.name: Dara laut benggala
species.summary: The lesser crested tern (Thalasseus bengalensis) is a tern in the family, Laridae.

species.name: Daralaut tiram
species.summary: Dara-laut tiram (bahasa Latin = Sterna nilotica) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Sternidae, dari genus Sterna.

species.name: Kepudang-Sungu Gunung
species.summary: The Sunda cuckooshrike (Coracina larvata) is a species of bird in the Campephagidae family. It is found in Indonesia and Malaysia, where it occurs on Borneo, Sumatra and Java. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist montane forests.

species.name: Alap-alap kawah
species.summary: Alap-alap kawah (Falco peregrinus) atau Peregrine Falcon dalam bahasa Inggris adalah salah satu spesies alap-alap berukuran besar, dengan panjang sekitar 50 cm. Burung ini memiliki bulu berwarna hitam, kelabu dan biru, berparuh kuning besar dengan ujung hitam lancip dan berekor pendek.

species.name: Tepus Kepala-Hitam
species.summary: The grey-throated babbler (Stachyris nigriceps) is a species of bird in the Timaliidae family.

Balistapus undulatus, also known as the Orange-lined triggerfish is a demersal marine fish belonging to the family Balistidae, the triggerfishes. It is the only member of the monotypic genus Balistapus....

species.name: Burung-Madu Belukar
species.summary: Burung-madu Belukar adalah spesies burung yang mempunyai paruh, berdarah panas, dan membiak dengan cara bertelur.

species.name: Cinenen Merah
species.summary: Cinenen merah Orthotomus sericeus adalah spesies burung yang endemik Indonesia dan Malaysia.

species.name: Wiwik Lurik
species.summary: Wiwik Lurik atau dalam nama ilmiahnya Cacomantis sonneratii adalah sejenis burung yang terdapat dalam suku Cuculidae.
The Chinese trumpetfish, Aulostomus chinensis, is a demersal marine fish belonging to the family Aulostomidae.

species.name: Ular Gadung
species.summary: Ular gadung adalah sejenis ular berbisa lemah yang tidak berbahaya dari suku Colubridae. Secara umum, di wilayah Indonesia barat ular ini disebut dengan nama ular pucuk. Nama-nama daerahnya di antaranya oray pucuk (Sd.), ula gadung (Jw.), dan lain-lain. Dalam bahasa Inggris dikenal sebagai Oriental whip-snake....

species.name: Katak Tegalan
species.summary: Kodok tegalan atau katak tegalan (Fejervarya limnocharis) adalah sejenis kodok berukuran sedang anggota suku Dicroglossidae. Ada pula yang menyebutnya sebagai kodok sawah, atau kadang-kadang bancet; nama yang tidak tepat.
The blackspotted puffer (Arothron nigropunctatus), also known as the dog-faced puffer, is a tropical marine fish belonging to the family Tetraodontidae.

species.name: Cekakak Merah
species.summary: Cekakak merah (Halcyon coromanda) adalah spesies burung raja-udang dalam famili Halcyonidae.

species.name: Kepinis-Jarum Gedang
species.summary: The brown-backed needletail (Hirundapus giganteus), or brown needletail, is a large swift.

species.name: Pelatuk Sayap-Merah
species.summary: The crimson-winged woodpecker (Picus puniceus) is a species of bird in the woodpecker family. It is found in Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, Singapore, and Thailand. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests. It can grow up to 25 cm long. Its diet is mainly insects and larvae.

The moon wrasse (also known as crescent wrasse) (Thalassoma lunare) is a species of wrasse native to the Indian Ocean and the western Pacific Ocean. It is an inhabitant of coral reefs and surrounding areas at depths from 1 to 20 m (3.3 to 65.6 ft).

species.name: Kadalan Selaya
species.summary: Raffles's malkoha (Rhinortha chlorophaea) is a species of cuckoo (family Cuculidae). It was formerly often placed in Phaenicophaeus with the other malkohas, but it is a rather distinct species, with several autapomorphies and sexual dimorphism (which its presumed relatives all lack).

species.name: Kerakbasi Ramai
species.summary: The clamorous reed warbler (Acrocephalus stentoreus) is an Old World warbler in the genus Acrocephalus. It breeds from Egypt eastwards through Pakistan, Afghanistan and northernmost India to south China, southeast Asia and south to Australia. A. s. meridionalis is an endemic race in Sri Lanka.

species.name: Trinil Rawa
species.summary: Tringa stagnatilis adalah burung perandai kecil. Ini adalah betis yang agak kecil, dan berkembang biak di padang rumput terbuka dan lahan basah taiga dari Eropa paling timur ke Timur Jauh Rusia.

species.name: Paok laus
species.summary: Paok laus (Pitta elegans) adalah spesies burung dari famili Pittidae. Habitat burung ini berada di hutan tropis atau hutan subtropis lembap yang berada di dataran rendah.

The threespot dascyllus (Dascyllus trimaculatus), also known as the domino damsel or simply domino, is a species of damselfish from the family Pomacentridae. It is native to the Indo-Pacific from the Red Sea and East Africa, to the Pitcairn Islands, southern Japan, and Australia.
Junonia orithya adalah salah satu spesies serangga.

species.name: Burung-Madu Ekor-Merah
species.summary: Burung-madu ekor-merah (bahasa Latin: Aethopyga temminckii) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Nectariniidae, dari genus Aethopyga. Burung ini memiliki habitat di hutan sekunder, hutan terbuka, perbukitan, gunung. tersebar antara ketinggian 800-1.200 m dpl.

species.name: Bajing Kelapa
species.habitat: Primarily inhabits lowland tropical rainforest and possibly secondary forest and forest edges on Simeulue Island. Likely dependent on continuous canopy cover for arboreal locomotion and foraging.
species.summary: Bajing kelapa (Callosciurus notatus) adalah sejenis mamalia pengerat kecil yang termasuk keluarga Sciuridae (bajing) yang ditemukan di Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapura, dan Thailand di berbagai habitat seperti hutan, bakau, taman, kebun, dan kawasan pertanian. Hewan ini dalam bahasa Inggris disebut Plantain squirrel.

species.name: Burung laut
species.summary: Zebrasoma scopas, the brown tang, twotone tang, scopas tang or brush-tail tang, is a marine reef tang in the fish family Acanthuridae. The brown tang is found throughout Oceania and is a herbivorous fish, feeding predominantly on filamentous algae. It is a highly popular fish in the aquarium trade.

species.name: Kepudang-Sungu Kecil
species.summary: The lesser cuckooshrike (Lalage fimbriata) is a species of bird in the Campephagidae family. It is found in Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, Singapore, and Thailand.

species.name: Capung Kembara
species.summary: Pantala flavescens, the globe skimmer, globe wanderer or wandering glider, is a wide-ranging dragonfly of the family Libellulidae. This species and Pantala hymenaea, the "spot-winged glider", are the only members of the genus Pantala from the subfamily Pantalinae. It was first described by Fabricius in 1798.

species.name: Kedidi Jari-Panjang
species.summary: The long-toed stint, Calidris subminuta, is a small wader. The genus name is from Ancient Greek kalidris or skalidris, a term used by Aristotle for some grey-coloured waterside birds. The specific subminuta is from Latin sub, "near to" and minuta, "small" from its similarity to the little stint, Calidris minuta.

species.name: Tepekong Rangkang
species.summary: Tepekong rangkang (Hemiprocne comata, bahasa Inggris: whiskered treeswift) adalah spesies burung dalam familia Hemiprocnidae. Spesies ini adalah spesies terkecil dari empat spesies dalam genus Hemiprocne dan ditemukan di Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, Filipina, Singapura, dan Thailand.

species.name: Capung-Jemur Oranye
species.summary: Brachythemis contaminata, ditch jewel, is a species of dragonfly in the family Libellulidae. It is found in many Asian countries.

species.name: Belalang Kayu
species.summary: Valanga nigricornis, the Javanese grasshopper, is a species of grasshopper in the subfamily Cyrtacanthacridinae of the family Acrididae. It is found in southeastern Asia, the type location being Singapore. It was first described by the German zoologist Hermann Burmeister in 1838.

species.name: Capung-Jarum Centil
species.summary: Agriocnemis femina, the variable wisp or pinhead wisp, is a species of damselfly in the family Coenagrionidae. It is a small damselfly; mature males have a white pruinescence over their body, and a dark tail. It is found from India, through South-east Asia to islands in the Pacific.

species.name: Capung-Jala Kecil
species.summary: The Red Grasshawk, also known as Common Parasol, and Grasshawk dragonfly, (Neurothemis fluctuans) is a species of dragonfly in the family Libellulidae. It is widespread in many Asian countries.

species.name: Capung-Jarum Sawah
species.summary: Ischnura senegalensis, also known variously as common bluetail, marsh bluetail, ubiquitous bluetail, African bluetail, and Senegal golden dartlet, is a widespread damselfly of the family Coenagrionidae.

species.name: Manyar Jambul
species.summary: The streaked weaver (Ploceus manyar) is a species of weaver bird found in South Asia and South-east Asia in the countries of Bangladesh, Bhutan, Cambodia, China, Egypt, India, Indonesia, Myanmar, Nepal, Pakistan, Singapore, Sri Lanka, Thailand, Vietnam and also introduced in Qatar and United Arab Emirates (UAE).

species.name: Barong Horsfield
species.summary: The intermediate roundleaf bat (Hipposideros larvatus) is a species of bat in the family Hipposideridae. It is found in Bangladesh, Cambodia, China, India, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, Thailand, and Vietnam.

species.name: Bangkong Sungai
species.summary: The Asian giant toad (Phrynoidis asper), sometimes referred to as the river toad, is a large toad native to Southeast Asia.
The striated surgeonfish, Ctenochaetus striatus, is a species of marine fish in the family Acanthuridae.

species.name: Ular Tambang
species.summary: Ular tambang atau Ular tali picis adalah spesies ular pohon dari familia Colubridae. Nama-nama lokal ular ini diantaranya: "ulo tambang" atau "ulo tampar" (Bhs. Jawa), "olar kandilis" (Bhs. Madura) dan "duwata" atau "ule lewora" (Bhs. Toraja).

species.name: Trinil Bedaran
species.summary: Trinil bedaran (bahasa Latin = Xenus cinereus) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Scolopacidae, dari genus Xenus. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan cacing, krutasea, moluska kecil, binatang laut lain yang memiliki habitat di gosong lumpur, pantai, teluk, muara sungai.

species.name: Cinenen Belukar
species.summary: Cinenen belukar adalah spesies burung yang mempunyai paruh, berdarah panas, dan membiak dengan cara bertelur.

species.name: Tikusan Merah
species.summary: The ruddy-breasted crake (Porzana fusca), or ruddy crake, is a waterbird in the rail and crake family Rallidae.

Pomacentrus moluccensis, the lemon damselfish, is a species of bony fish in the family Pomacentridae, from the Western Pacific Ocean. It occasionally makes its way into the aquarium trade. It grows to a size of 9 cm (4 in) in length.

The red lionfish (Pterois volitans) is a venomous coral reef fish in the family Scorpaenidae, order Scorpaeniformes. P. volitans is natively found in the Indo-Pacific region, but has become an invasive problem in the Caribbean Sea, as well as along the East Coast of the United States.

species.name: Sikatan Biru-Muda
species.summary: Sikatan biru-muda (bahasa Latin: Cyornis unicolor) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Muscicapidae, dari genus Cyornis. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan serang dan memiliki habitat di hutan subtropik atau hutan tropik yang lembap.

species.name: Cekakak Batu
species.summary: Cekakak batu (Lacedo pulchella) adalah spesies burung cekakak dalam famili Halcyonidae.
The Blackeye thicklip wrasse or Half-and-half wrasse (Hemigymnus melapterus) is a species of fish belonging to the wrasse family. It is native to the Indo-Pacific.
The Indo-Pacific sergeant (Abudefduf vaigiensis) may also be known as the Sergeant major although this name is usually reserved for the closely related species Abudefduf saxatilis.

The black-sided hawkfish, freckled hawkfish or Forster's hawkfish (Paracirrhites forsteri), is a species of hawkfish from the Indo-Pacific. It is occasionally found in the aquarium trade and is also of minor importance to local commercial fisheries. It grows to a total length of 22 cm (9 in).

species.name: Pentis Pelangi
species.summary: The crimson-breasted flowerpecker (Prionochilus percussus) is a species of bird in the Dicaeidae family. It is found in Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, and Thailand. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests and subtropical or tropical mangrove forests.

Amblyglyphidodon curacao also known as the staghorn damselfish is a species of marine fish in the family Pomacentridae, the damselfishes and the clownfishes. It's widespread throughout the tropical waters of the western Pacific Ocean. This species is a small sized fish that can reach a maximum size of 11cm length.

The Oval Butterflyfish, Red-finned Butterflyfish or redfin butterflyfish (Chaetodon lunulatus) is a species of butterflyfish (family Chaetodontidae). It is found in the Pacific Ocean from Eastern Indonesia to the Hawaiian islands.

The regal angelfish (Pygoplites diacanthus) or royal angelfish, is a species of marine angelfish of the family Pomacanthidae, and the monotypic genus Pygoplites. It is found in tropical Indo-Pacific oceans. It can grow as long as 25 cm.

species.name: Kadal Rumput
species.summary: Kadal rumput adalah sejenis kadal bertubuh panjang ramping anggota dari suku Lacertidae. Orang Sunda menyebutnya orong-orong. Sedangkan dalam bahasa Inggris hewan ini dikenal sebagai Asian grass lizard, six-striped long-tailed lizard, atau long-tailed grass lizard.

The vagabond butterflyfish (Chaetodon vagabundus) is a species of butterflyfish (family Chaetodontidae). It is found in the Indo-Pacific region from the Red Sea and off East Africa as far east as the Tuamotu Islands, north to southern Japan and south to the Austral Islands.

species.name: Pelatuk Kijang
species.summary: The rufous woodpecker, (Micropternus brachyurus) is a brown woodpecker found in southern, eastern and northern India, Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh, Myanmar, southern China, Thailand, Laos, Cambodia, Vietnam, Malaysia, Singapore, Brunei and Indonesia (Sumatra, Borneo and western Java).

The titan triggerfish, giant triggerfish or moustache triggerfish (Balistoides viridescens) is a large species of triggerfish found in lagoons and at reefs to depths of 50 m (160 ft) in most of the Indo-Pacific, though it is absent from Hawaii.

species.name: Cikrak Bambu
species.summary: Cikrak bambu (bahasa Latin: Abroscopus superciliaris) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Cettiidae, dari genus Abroscopus. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan serangga kecil, lalat, ulat, telur serangga, dan laba-laba. Burung ini berhabitat di hutan sekunder bambu, semak, tersebar sampai ketinggian 1.500 m dpl.

species.name: Jingjing Bukit
species.summary: The bar-winged flycatcher-shrike (Hemipus picatus) is a small passerine bird formerly placed in the cuckooshrike family but probably closer to the woodshrikes. It is found in the forests of tropical southern Asia from the Himalayas and hills of southern India to Indonesia.

species.name: Pelatuk Kumis-Kelabu
species.summary: The checker-throated woodpecker, checker-throated yellownape, or Javan yellownape (Chrysophlegma mentale) is a species of bird in the family Picidae native to Southeast Asia.

species.name: Pelatuk Merah
species.summary: The banded woodpecker (Chrysophlegma miniaceum) or the banded red woodpecker is a species of bird in the family Picidae. It is found in Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, Singapore, and Thailand. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests and subtropical or tropical mangrove forests.

Junonia almana, the peacock pansy, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in South Asia. It exists in two distinct adult forms, which differ chiefly in the patterns on the underside of the wings; the dry-season form has few markings, while the wet-season form has additional eyespots and lines.

species.name: Kodok Sawah
species.summary: Kodok sawah ialah sejenis katak yang banyak hidup di sawah-sawah, rawa, parit dan selokan, sampai ke rawa-rawa bakau.

Danaus chrysippus adalah spesies serangga yang tersebar luas di Asia, Afrika, dan Australia. Termasuk ke dalam keluarga Danainae dari keluarga kupu-kupu Nymphalidae. Larva Danaus chrysippus utamanya mengkonsumsi tanaman dalam genus Asclepias, lebih sering disebut milkweed (getah susu) seperti pohon widuri.

species.name: Takur gedang
species.summary: Takur gedang (Psilopogon chrysopogon) adalah spesies takur dalam famili Megalaimidae. Spesies ini terdapat di Kepulauan Melayu barat, tempat mereka mendiami hutan hingga ketinggian 1.500 m (4.900 ft). Spesies ini dinilai sebagai Risiko Rendah dan Daftar Merah IUCN sejak 2004 kerana sebarannya yang meluas.

species.name: Kongkang Racun
species.summary: Kongkang racun adalah nama sejenis kodok dari suku Ranidae. Nama ilmiahnya adalah Odorrana hosii Boulenger, 1891. Orang Sunda menyebutnya kolé héjo. Sedangkan namanya dalam bahasa Inggris adalah poisonous rock-frog. Diberi nama demikian karena kulitnya mengandung kelenjar racun yang mampu membunuh hewan-hewan kecil.

The sixbar wrasse or six-banded wrasse (Thalassoma hardwicke) is a species of wrasse in the family Labridae, native to the Indian Ocean and the western Pacific Ocean. It is an inhabitant of reef environments at depths from the surface down to 15 m (50 ft).

species.name: Pijantung Gunung
species.summary: Pijantung gunung (Arachnothera affinis) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga burung madu (Nectariniidae).

species.name: Bentet Coklat
species.summary: The brown shrike (Lanius cristatus) is a bird in the shrike family that is found mainly in Asia. It is closely related to the red-backed shrike (L. collurio) and isabelline shrike (L. isabellinus).

species.name: Kedidi Putih
species.summary: Kedidi putih (Calidris alba) adalah sejenis burung perandai atau burung pantai yang berukuran sedang. Burung ini berbiak di wilayah lingkar kutub Arktika; di musim dingin bermigrasi jauh ke selatan hingga Eropa selatan, Amerika Selatan, Afrika, Asia Tenggara, dan Australasia.

species.name: Cabai Merah
species.summary: Cabai merah (bahasa Latin: Dicaeum cruentatum) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Dicaeidae, dari genus Dicaeum. Burung ini memiliki habitat di hutan sekunder, pekarangan, perkebunan. tersebar sampai ketinggian 1.000 m dpl.

species.name: Pelatuk Ayam
species.summary: Pelatuk ayam adalah spesies burung yang mempunyai paruh, berdarah panas, dan membiak dengan cara bertelur.

species.name: Kadalan Kembang
species.summary: The red-billed malkoha (Phaenicophaeus javanicus) is a species of cuckoo in the family Cuculidae. It is found in Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, and Thailand. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical dry forests.

species.name: Capung-sambar biru
species.summary: Orthetrum glaucum is an Asian dragonfly species, common across much of tropical and subtropical Asia, and capable of thriving in disturbed habitats. It breeds in ponds, drains, ditches and other open lentic habitats.

Amphiprion perideraion also known as the pink skunk clownfish or pink anemonefish, is a species of anemonefish from the skunk complex that is widespread from northern Australia through the Malay Archipelago and Melanesia.

species.name: Bondol kalimantan
species.summary: Bondol Kalimantan (Lonchura fuscans) adalah sejenis burung kecil pemakan biji-bijian yang tergolong dalam suku Estrildidae. Sebelumnya, burung ini dimasukkan sebagai anggota suku Ploceidae. Burung ini diketahui hidup terbatas (endemik) di Kalimantan.
Zizina otis, the lesser grass blue, is a species of blue (Lycaenidae) butterfly found in south Asia. The lesser grass blue is often misidentified as Zizina labradus, the common grass blue.
Amblyglyphidodon aureus also known as the golden damselfish is a species of marine fish in the family Pomacentridae, the damselfishes and clownfishes. It is native to the central Indo-Pacific.

species.name: Sempur-hujan Sungai
species.summary: Cymbirhynchus macrorhynchos atau sempur-hujan sungai adalah spesies burung dalam keluarga paruh lebar Asia, Eurylaimidae. Ini adalah satu-satunya spesies dalam genus Cymbirhynchus.

Neoglyphidodon nigroris, common name black-and-gold chromis or Behn's damsel is a damselfish from the Indo-West Pacific. It occasionally makes its way into the aquarium trade. It grows to a size of 13 centimetres (5.1 in) in total length.

Pterois antennata, the spotfin lionfish, banded lionfish, broadbarred lionfish, broadbarred firefish, raggedfinned firefish, raggedfinned scorpionfish or roughscaled lionfish, is a species of marine ray-finned fish belonging to the family Scorpaenidae, the scorpionfishes and lionfishes.

Amphiprion biaculeatus, umumnya dikenal sebagai ikan balong padang atau balong saja, adalah spesies ikan badut yang ditemukan di Indo-Pasifik dari Indonesia bagian barat hingga Taiwan dan Great Barrier Reef . Mereka bisa tumbuh menjadi sekitar 17 cm (6,7 in).

species.name: Brinji Rambut-Tunggir
species.summary: The hairy-backed bulbul (Tricholestes criniger) is a songbird species in the bulbul family, Pycnonotidae. It is the sole species contained within the monotypic genus Tricholestes. It is found on the Malay Peninsula, Sumatra, and Borneo. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests.

species.name: Sikatan Dada-Merah
species.summary: The rufous-chested flycatcher (Ficedula dumetoria) is a species of bird in the family Muscicapidae. It is found in Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, and Thailand. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests and subtropical or tropical moist montane forests. It is threatened by habitat loss.

species.name: Capung-Tengger Loreng
species.summary: Agrionoptera insignis is a species of dragonfly in the family Libellulidae. It is native to much of eastern Asia and Oceania, occurring as far north as Japan and as far south as Australia. It is common in most of its range.

species.name: Kongkang Gading
species.summary: Kongkang gading adalah nama sejenis kodok dari suku Ranidae. Nama ilmiahnya adalah Rana erythraea (Schlegel, 1837), yakni berasal dari nama sebuah kota kecil di Asia Tengah (Iskandar, 1998). Dalam bahasa Inggris, dikenal dengan nama golden-lined frog, green paddy frog, green lotus frog atau common greenback.

species.name: Cabak Gunung
species.summary: Salvadori's nightjar (Caprimulgus pulchellus) is a species of nightjar in the family Caprimulgidae. It is endemic to Indonesia, where it is found in Sumatra and Java.

Melanitis leda, the common evening brown, is a common species of butterfly found flying at dusk. The flight of this species is erratic. They are found in Africa, South Asia and South-east Asia extending to parts of Australia.

species.name: Sikatan Mugimaki
species.summary: The mugimaki flycatcher (Ficedula mugimaki) is a small passerine bird of eastern Asia belonging to the genus Ficedula in the Old World flycatcher family, Muscicapidae. The name "mugimaki" comes from Japanese and means "wheat-sower". The bird is also known as the robin flycatcher.

species.name: Cecak Gula
species.summary: The four-clawed gecko (Gehyra mutilata, also known as the stump-toed gecko, tender-skinned house gecko, sugar lizard, or Pacific gecko, or butiki) is a wide-ranging lizard that is probably native to Southeast Asia. It has made its way to several areas of the world including Sri Lanka, Indochina, and many of the U.S.
The Sunda owlet (Taenioptynx sylvaticus) is a small owl from Sumatra.

species.name: Puyuh Batu
species.summary: Puyuh biru asia atau puyuh batu (Synoicus chinensis) adalah spesies burung puyuh yang mempunyai paruh, berdarah panas, dan bereproduksi dengan cara bertelur. Puyuh batu saat ini sudah banyak dikembangkan oleh kalangan penggemar dan kolektor unggas hias.

species.name: Walet Sarang-Hitam
species.summary: Walet sarang-hitam (Collocalia maxima) adalah sejenis burung anggota suku Apodidae. Walet ini didapati menyebar di Brunei, Burma, Filipina, Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapura, Thailand, dan Vietnam.

species.name: Asi Topi-Sisik
species.summary: The scaly-crowned babbler (Malacopteron cinereum) is a species of bird in the Pellorneidae family. It is found in Brunei, Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Thailand, and Vietnam. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests.

Plectorhinchus chaetodonoides, the harlequin sweetlips, is a species of grunt native to the Indian Ocean and the western Pacific Ocean. It is a denizen of coral reefs found at depths of from 1 to 30 m (3.3 to 98.4 ft). It can reach 72 cm (28 in) in TL. The heaviest known individual weighed 7 kg (15 lb).

Cephalopholis miniata, known commonly as the coral hind, is a species of marine fish in the family Serranidae. Other names include miniatus grouper, miniata grouper, coral or blue-spot rockcod, vermilion seabass, and coral grouper.

species.name: Punai Lengguak
species.summary: Punai lengguak (Treron curvirostra) adalah spesies burung pada famili Columbidae. Mereka dapat ditemukan di Bangladesh, Bhutan, Brunei, Kamboja, Tiongkok, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, Nepal, Filipina, Singapura, Thailand, dan Vietnam. Di Kalimantan Barat, punai ini mempunyai sebutan punai oto.

The giant moray (Gymnothorax javanicus) is a species of moray eel and a species of marine fish in the family Muraenidae. In terms of body mass, it is the largest moray eel (the slender giant moray is longer).

species.name: Capung Sambar Merah
species.summary: Orthetrum pruinosum, the crimson-tailed marsh hawk, is a species of dragonfly in the family Libellulidae. It is a widespread species occurring from west India to Japan and south to Java and the Sunda Islands. It breeds in puddles, ponds and tanks. Three subspecies are recognized.

species.name: Tukik Tikus
species.summary: The rufous piculet (Sasia abnormis) is a species of bird in the family Picidae. It is found in Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, and Thailand. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests and subtropical or tropical moist montane forests.

species.name: Pipit Benggala
species.summary: Pipit benggala (bahasa Latin: Amandava amandava) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Estrildidae, dari genus Amandava. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan padi, biji rumpu dan memiliki habitat di semak, padang rumput, lahan pertanian, sawah, rumpun gelagah. Tersebar sampai ketinggian 1.500 m dpl.

The black-breasted myzomela or red-rumped myzomela (Myzomela vulnerata) is a species of bird in the family Meliphagidae. It is found in Indonesia and East Timor. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical dry forests.

species.name: Kepinis-Jarum Kecil
species.summary: Kapinis-jarum kecil (bahasa Latin = Rhaphidura leucopygialis) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Apodidae, dari genus Rhaphidura. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan serangga kecil yang memiliki habitat di hutan, hutan terbuka, tersebar sampai ketinggian 1.500 m dpl.

The tail-spot wrasse, Halichoeres melanurus, is a species of wrasse in the western Pacific from Japan to Samoa and Tonga and south to the Great Barrier Reef. This species is found along rocky shores or on coral reefs at depths from 1 to 15 m (3.3 to 49.2 ft). It can reach 12 cm (4.7 in) in total length.

species.name: Capung-Sambar Senja
species.summary: Tholymis tillarga, the coral-tailed cloudwing, is a species of dragonfly in the family Libellulidae. It is found from tropical West Africa to Asia, Australia and the Pacific Islands. Common names include old world twister, evening skimmer, crepuscular darter, and foggy-winged twister.

species.name: Cecak batu
species.summary: Cecak batu adalah sejenis reptil yang termasuk suku cecak (Gekkonidae). Tidak ada nama khusus yang dikenal dalam bahasa daerah. Dalam bahasa Inggris cecak ini disebut dengan sebagai Javan bent-toed gecko.

species.name: Ikan Lele Laut
species.summary: Plotosus lineatus, common name striped eel catfish, is a species of eeltail catfishes belonging to the family Plotosidae.
Chlorurus bleekeri, known commonly as Bleeker's parrotfish , is a species of marine fish in the family Scaridae.

species.name: Capung-Sambar Dada-Karat
species.summary: Brachydiplax chalybea is a species of dragonfly in the family Libellulidae. It is known by the common names yellow-patched lieutenant, rufous-backed marsh hawk, and blue dasher. It is native to much of eastern Asia, from India to Japan to Indonesia. It is common and widespread.

The black stream glider, indigo dropwing (Trithemis festiva) is a species of dragonfly in the family Libellulidae. It is a very widespread species, occurring from Greece, Cyprus and Turkey, throughout Asia to New Guinea.

species.name: Pelatuk Pangkas
species.summary: Pelatuk pangkas adalah spesies burung yang mempunyai paruh, berdarah panas, dan membiak dengan cara bertelur.

species.name: Taktarau Melayu
species.summary: The Malaysian eared nightjar (Lyncornis temminckii) is a species of nightjar in the family Caprimulgidae. It is found in Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, and Thailand. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests.

species.name: Cerek tilil
species.summary: Cerek tilil (bahasa Latin = Anarhynchus alexandrinus) adalah spesies burung dari famili Charadriidae, dari genus Anarhynchus. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan krustasea, cacing laut yang memiliki habitat di pantai, sungai, paya-paya, tambak, padang rumput berpasir.
Nephilengys malabarensis is a araneid spider.
Dendrochirus zebra, known commonly as the zebra turkeyfish or zebra lionfish among other vernacular names, is a species of marine fish in the family Scorpaenidae.
Stegastes lacrymatus, the whitespotted devil, also known as the jewel damselfish, lives in the Indo-Pacific and can grow up to 10 centimetres (3.9 in) in length.

species.name: Belentung
species.summary: Belentung atau belentuk adalah nama sejenis kodok kecil yang bersuara nyaring. Karena bunyi dengkungnya itu, banyak orang yang menyangka hewan ini bertubuh besar (lihat misalnya pada KBBI). Orang Jakarta menyebutnya kodok blentung, sedangkan orang Jawa menamainya kintel.

species.name: Punggok Coklat
species.summary: Punggok cokelat:65 (Ninox scutulata) adalah spesies burung hantu dalam famili Strigidae. Burung ini tersebar luas mulai dari India di barat, ke timur melalui Asia Tenggara hingga ke Cina selatan, Kalimantan, dan Palawan; ke selatan hingga Pulau Jawa.

The six-line wrasse, Pseudocheilinus hexataenia, is a species of wrasse native to the Indian Ocean and the western Pacific Ocean. This species inhabits coral reefs at depths from 1 to 35 m (3.3 to 114.8 ft). It can reach 10 cm (3.9 in) in total length. It can also be found in the aquarium trade.

species.name: Empuloh Irang
species.summary: The yellow-bellied bulbul (Alophoixus phaeocephalus) is a species of songbird in the bulbul family, Pycnonotidae. It is found on the Malay Peninsula, Sumatra and Borneo. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests.

species.name: Codot Krawar
species.summary: Codot krawar (Cynopterus brachyotis) adalah sejenis kelelawar anggota suku codot (Pteropodidae). Kelelawar pemakan buah ini hidup tersebar luas mulai dari Nepal, India, Sri Lanka, Asia Tenggara, Filipina, dan Indonesia (Sumatra, Kalimantan, Jawa, Bali, dan Maluku).

species.name: Caladi Tikotok
species.summary: The red-crested woodpecker is a species of bird in the family Picidae. It is endemic to the island of Java in Indonesia. Hemicircus concretus and Hemicircus sordidus were previously lumped together as H. concretus.

The Indian Ocean oriental sweetlips, Plectorhinchus vittatus, is a species of grunt native to the Indian Ocean and the western Pacific Ocean. This species can be found on both coral and rock reefs at depths from 2 to 25 m (6.6 to 82.0 ft).

species.name: Capung-sambar perut-kait
species.summary: The Spine-tufted skimmer, or Crimson-tailed marsh Hawk, brown-backed red marsh hawk, (Orthetrum chrysis) is a species of dragonfly in the family Libellulidae. It is widespread in many Asian countries.

species.name: Cabai polos
species.summary: The plain flowerpecker (Dicaeum minullum) is a species of bird in the Dicaeidae family. It is found in the central Himalayas, through western Indonesia to Taiwan.

species.name: Burung-Madu Rimba
species.summary: The purple-naped sunbird (Kurochkinegramma hypogrammicum) is a species of bird in the family Nectariniidae. It is the only species in the genus Kurochkinegramma. It is found in Southeast Asia from Myanmar to Sumatra and Borneo. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests.

species.name: Paok hijau
species.summary: The hooded pitta (Pitta sordida) is a passerine bird. It is common in eastern and southeastern Asia and maritime Southeast Asia, where it lives in several types of forests as well as on plantations and other cultivated areas. It is a green bird with a black head and chestnut crown.

The black-backed butterflyfish or blackback butterflyfish (Chaetodon melannotus) is a species of butterflyfish (family Chaetodontidae). It is widespread through the Indo-Pacific area from the Red Sea and East Africa to Samoa, to southern Japan and throughout Micronesia.

species.name: Cirik-Cirik Kumbang
species.summary: Cirik-cirik kumbang (Nyctyornis amictus) adalah spesies burung kirik-kirik berukuran besar yang ditemukan di Myanmar selatan, Semenanjung Malaya, Kalimantan, Sumatra, dan pulau-pulau kecil di sekitarnya. Spesies ini ditemukan di celah-celah di dalam hutan lebat.

species.name: Capung-Loreng Tombak
species.summary: Ictinogomphus decoratus, the common flangetail, is a species of clubtail dragonfly found in Southeast Asia.

species.name: Philentoma Sayap-Merah
species.summary: The rufous-winged philentoma (Philentoma pyrhoptera) is a bird species. Long placed in the flycatcher family (Muscicapidae) when these were used as a "wastebin taxon", they are now tentatively assigned to the Tephrodornithidae pending detailed study.

species.name: Capung-jemur merah-jambu
species.summary: Trithemis aurora, the crimson marsh glider, is a species of dragonfly in the family Libellulidae. It is a medium-sized dragonfly that is commonly found in weedy tanks and ponds, marshes, channels, and slow flowing streams and rivers in the lowlands and mid-hills. It breeds in streams, rivers, canals, ponds and tanks.

species.name: Tangkar kambing
species.summary: The black magpie (Platysmurus leucopterus) is a species of bird in the family Corvidae. Despite its name, it is neither a magpie nor, as was long believed, a jay, but a treepie. Treepies are a distinct group of corvids externally similar to magpies. It is monotypic within the genus Platysmurus.

Rhinolophus affinis atau prok-bruk hutan, adalah spesies kelelawar famili Rhinolophidae yang tersebar luas di Asia Selatan, Asia Tenggara dan Tiongkok. Kelelawar ini dianggap sebagai spesies risiko rendah oleh IUCN, karena penyebarannya yang luas dan tanpa ada ancaman besar yang diketahui.

images.credit: The Darwin Initiative Centre for Bat Research

species.name: Burung-Madu Polos
species.summary: The plain sunbird (Anthreptes simplex) is a species of bird in the Nectariniidae family. It is found in Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, Singapore, and Thailand. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests and subtropical or tropical mangrove forests.

species.name: Elang gunung
species.summary: Elang gunung (Nisaetus alboniger) merupakan salah satu jenis burung pemangsa berukuran sedang dari keluarga Accipitridae dan Genus Nisaetus yang dijumpai di semanjung Malaysia dan Indonesia. Secara tradisional elang gunung ditempatkan di genus Spizaetus, tetapi studi terbaru oleh Helbig et al.

Plagiotremus rhinorhynchos, commonly called the bluestriped fangblenny, is a species of combtooth blenny found in coral reefs in the Pacific and Indian ocean. This species reaches a length of 12 centimetres (4.7 in) SL.
Clown triggerfish (Balistoides conspicillum), also known as the bigspotted triggerfish, are demersal marine fish belonging to the family Balistidae, or commonly called triggerfish.

species.name: Sanca Kembang
species.summary: The reticulated python (Python reticulatus) is a species of python found in Southeast Asia. They are the world's longest snakes and longest reptiles, and among the three heaviest snakes. Like all pythons, they are nonvenomous constrictors and normally not considered dangerous to humans.
The white-spotted puffer (Arothron hispidus) is a medium to large-sized puffer fish, it can reach 50 cm length.

Pomacentrus coelestis (neon damselfish) is a species of damselfish in the family Pomacentridae. It is found in the Indo-Pacific. It can grow to a maximum size of 9 centimetres (3.5 in) in length. It occasionally makes its way into the aquarium trade.

The Sunda scimitar babbler (Pomatorhinus bornensis) is a species of bird in the family Timaliidae. It is endemic to Sumatra, Borneo, and Malaysia. The Sunda scimitar babbler and the Javan scimitar babbler being grouped as the chestnut-backed scimitar babbler.

species.name: Perling Kumbang
species.summary: Perling kumbang (Aplonis panayensis) adalah spesies burung dari famili jalak-jalakan (Sturnidae). Tersebar luas di Asia Selatan dan Asia Tenggara. Hidup berkelompok, kerap datang berkunjung dan menetap di area perkotaan yang memiliki pohon berbuah kecil seperti beringin.

species.name: Lobster Bambu
species.summary: Menurut Spence (1989), lobster terdiri dari kepala dan thorax yang tertutup oleh karapas dan memiliki abdomen yang terdiri dari enam segmen.
The dash-and-dot goatfish (Parupeneus barberinus) is a species of goatfish native to the Indian and Pacific oceans.

species.name: Punai Kecil
species.summary: Punai kecil adalah spesies burung. Ia mempunyai paruh, berdarah panas, dan bereproduksi dengan cara bertelur.
Acanthurus nigricauda is a tropical fish with the common name epaulette surgeonfish.

species.name: Kepudang Hutan
species.summary: The dark-throated oriole (Oriolus xanthonotus) is a species of bird in the family Oriolidae.

species.name: Ular Siput
species.summary: Ular siput (Pareas carinatus) adalah sejenis ular kecil anggota suku Colubridae. Dinamai demikian baik karena mangsa utamanya adalah aneka siput kecil, maupun karena gerakannya yang lamban seperti mangsanya itu.

species.name: Pelanduk Bukit
species.summary: The Temminck's babbler (Pellorneum pyrrogenys) is a species of bird in the Pellorneidae family. It is found in Borneo and Java. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests.

species.name: Madi Injap
species.summary: Madi injap (Psarisomus dalhousiae) adalah spesies burung madi dalam famili Eurylaimidae.

species.name: Paruh-Kodok Tanduk
species.summary: The Sunda frogmouth (Batrachostomus cornutus) is a species of bird, typically placed in the family Podargidae of the order Caprimulgiformes.

Nannophya pygmaea, known variously as the scarlet dwarf, northern pygmyfly, or tiny dragonfly, is a dragonfly of the family Libellulidae, native from Southeast Asia to China and Japan, occasionally found south to Australia.

species.name: Pentis Raja
species.summary: The yellow-breasted flowerpecker (Prionochilus maculatus) is a species of bird in the family Dicaeidae. It is found in Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, Singapore, and Thailand. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forest and subtropical or tropical moist montane forest.

Pari tutul-biru ekor-pita (Taeniura lymma) adalah sebuah spesies pari myliobatoid pada famili Dasyatidae. Pari ini dapat ditemukan dari zona intertidal hingga kedalaman 30 m, dan sering dijumpai diseluruh Samudra Pasifik barat dan Samudera Hindia tropis didekat pesisir dan habitat-habitat dekat terumbu karang.

species.name: Bentet Loreng
species.summary: Bentet loreng (Lanius tigrinus) adalah spesies burung dalam famili Laniidae. Burung ini adalah burung migran, bentet loreng berbiak di Asia Timur, China, dan Jepang. Saat musim dingin burung ini bermigrasi ke Semenanjung Malaysia dan Sunda Besar.

Graphium sarpedon, the common bluebottle or blue triangle in Australia, is a species of swallowtail butterfly, that is found in South and Southeast Asia, as well as eastern Australia. There are approximately sixteen subspecies with differing geographical distributions.

The bluespotted cornetfish, smooth cornetfish, or smooth flutemouth, Fistularia commersonii, is a marine fish which belongs to the family Fistulariidae. This very long and slender reef-dweller belongs to the same order as the pipefishes and seahorses, called Syngnathiformes.

species.name: Kepinis-Jarum Asia
species.summary: Kapinis-jarum asia (Hirundapus caudacutus) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Apodidae, dari genus Hirundapus. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan serangga kecil yang memiliki habitat di hutan, hutan terbuka.

species.name: Apate
species.summary: The snowflake moray (Echidna nebulosa) also known as the clouded moray among many various vernacular names, is a species of marine fish of the family Muraenidae.

species.name: Capung Terompet
species.summary: Acisoma panorpoides, the Asian pintail, trumpet tail, or grizzled pintail, is a species of dragonfly in the family Libellulidae.

species.name: Pelatuk Kundang
species.summary: The orange-backed woodpecker (Chrysocolaptes validus) is a bird in the woodpecker family Picidae, found in southern Thailand, Malaya, Sarawak and Sabah in Malaysia, Brunei, Sumatra, and Java. It is monotypic in the genus Reinwardtipicus. It is a forest specialist that is found primarily in the canopy.
Platax pinnatus, also known as the pinnate batfish, dusky batfish, shaded batfish, or red-faced batfish is a fish from the western Pacific that occasionally is kept in marine aquariums.

species.name: Wader Bintik-Dua
species.summary: Barbodes binotatus, commonly known as the spotted barb or common barb, is a tropical species of cyprinid fish native to Southeast Asia. It has also become established as an exotic species in Palau and Singapore.
The maxima clam (Tridacna maxima), also known as the small giant clam, is a species of bivalve mollusc found throughout the Indo-Pacific region.

species.name: Pelanduk Merah
species.summary: The ferruginous babbler (Pellorneum bicolor) is a species of bird in the family Pellorneidae. It is found in Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, and Thailand. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests.

species.name: Pergam Gunung
species.summary: The mountain imperial pigeon (Ducula badia), also known as the maroon-backed imperial pigeon or Hodgson's imperial pigeon, is a species of bird in the pigeon and dove family with a wide range in south-eastern Asia.

The blackbelly triggerfish (Rhinecanthus verrucosus) is a ray-finned fish in the family Balistidae found in the Indo-Pacific. It occasionally makes its way into the aquarium trade. It is sometimes known as the blackpatch triggerfish.

species.name: Kipasan Mutiara
species.summary: The spotted fantail (Rhipidura perlata) is a species of bird in the family Rhipiduridae.

species.name: Srigunting Keladi
species.summary: Srigunting keladi (Dicrurus aeneus) adalah burung Indomalayan kecil yang termasuk pada familia srigunting. Mereka menetap di hutan Subkontinen India dan Asia Tenggara. Mereka menangkap serangga terbang di bawah naungan hutan kanopi dengan membuat serangan tiba-tiba dari tenggeran mereka.

species.name: Capung-Tengger Ekor-Darah
species.summary: Lathrecista asiatica, the asiatic blood tail, is a species of dragonfly in the family Libellulidae. It is the only species in its genus. It breeds in ponds, marshes, swamp forest and shallow forest pools. It is widespread, occurring from India to Australia.

species.name: Terik asia
species.summary: Terik asia (Glareola maldivarum) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Glareolidae, dari genus Glareola. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan Serangga, cacing, invertebrat dan memiliki habitat di rawa-rawa, sawah, tersebar sampai ketinggian 500 m dpl.
Lampides boeticus, the pea blue, or long-tailed blue, is a small butterfly that belongs to the lycaenids or gossamer-winged family.
The honeycomb grouper or dwarf spotted rockcod (Epinephelus merra), also known by other vernacular names, is a species of marine fish in the family Serranidae.
The little bent-wing bat or little long-fingered bat (Miniopterus australis) is a species of vesper bat in the family Miniopteridae. It is found in Australia, Indonesia, the Philippines, and Vanuatu.
Chlorurus spilurus, known commonly as the Pacific daisy parrotfish or Pacific bullethead parrotfish, is a species of marine fish in the family Scaridae.
The pyramid butterflyfish (Hemitaurichthys polylepis) is a species of fish belonging to the family Chaetodontidae, native from central Indo-Pacific.

Hasarius adansoni adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Hasarius dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1826 oleh Audouin.

species.name: Asi Kumis
species.summary: Asi kumis (Malacopteron magnirostre) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Pellorneidae.

species.name: Madi Kelam
species.summary: The dusky broadbill (Corydon sumatranus) is a species of bird in the family Eurylaimidae, the broadbills. It is native to Southeast Asia. It may be slowly declining due to habitat loss, especially from logging, but it has a large enough range that it is still considered to be a least-concern species.

species.name: Kecici Belang
species.summary: Pallas's grasshopper warbler (Helopsaltes certhiola), also known as the rusty-rumped warbler, is an Old World warbler in the grass warbler genus Helopsaltes.

species.name: Kedasi Ungu
species.summary: The violet cuckoo (Chrysococcyx xanthorhynchus) is a species of cuckoo in the family Cuculidae.

Tokek berbintik (Gekko monarchus) adalah sejenis tokek yang kerap ditemukan di sekitar rumah, anggota dari suku Gekkonidae. Tokek yang bentuknya menyerupai cecak yang besar ini dalam bahasa Inggris dikenal sebagai Spotted House Gecko atau Warty House Gecko.

The tubelip wrasse (Labrichthys unilineatus) is a species of wrasse native to the Indian Ocean and the western Pacific Ocean. This species occurs in lagoons and on coral reefs at depths from 0 to 20 m (0 to 66 ft). This species grows to 17.5 cm (6.9 in) in total length.

Neoglyphidodon melas (bowtie damselfish, black damsel, bluefin or royal damsel) is a damselfish from the Indo-West Pacific. It occasionally makes its way into the aquarium trade. It grows to a size of 18 cm (7.1 in) in length.
Tridacna squamosa, known commonly as the fluted giant clam and scaly clam, is one of a number of large clam species native to the shallow coral reefs of the South Pacific and Indian Oceans.
Dascyllus aruanus, known commonly as the whitetail dascyllus or humbug damselfish among other vernacular names, is a species of marine fish in the family Pomacentridae.

species.name: Kupu-kupu raja helena
species.summary: Troides helena merupakan spesies kupu-kupu besar yang juga disebut Common Birdwing. Troides helena pertama kali di deskripsikan oleh Linnaeus pada tahun 1758. Bentangan sayapnya berkisar antara 13 sampai 17 cm. Kupu-kupu ini termasuk dalam suku Troidini pada family Papilionidae.
Bronchocela cristatella, also known as the green crested lizard, is a species of agamid lizard endemic to Southeast Asia.

Ceriagrion cerinorubellum, commonly known as the orange-tailed marsh dart or bi-coloured damsel, is a medium-sized species of damselfly in the family Coenagrionidae. They live around ponds, rivers, and canals. It is the most common species of damselflies in Asia.
Dischistodus perspicillatus, commonly known as the white damsel, is a fish native to the Andaman Sea and eastern Indian Ocean.
The spot-fin porcupinefish (Diodon hystrix), also known as spotted porcupinefish, black-spotted porcupinefish or simply porcupinefish, is a member of the family Diodontidae.

species.name: Sikatan Hijau-Laut
species.summary: The verditer flycatcher (Eumyias thalassinus) is an Old World flycatcher It is found from the Himalayas through Southeast Asia to Sumatra. This species is named after its distinctive shade of copper-sulphate blue and has a dark patch between the eyes and above the bill base.
Halichoeres scapularis, commonly called the Zigzag wrasse , is a fish species in the wrasse family native from the Indo-West Pacific.
The greyface moray, freckled moray, slender moray, or white-eyed moray, Gymnothorax thyrsoideus, is a species of marine fish in the family Muraenidae.

The grey-breasted spiderhunter (Arachnothera modesta) is a species of bird in the Nectariniidae family. It is found in Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, Singapore, Thailand, and Vietnam. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests and subtropical or tropical moist montane forests.

species.name: Ular Air Belang
species.summary: Ular-air belang (Homalopsis buccata) atau juga disebut ular kadut belang adalah spesies ular air yang tersebar luas di Asia bagian tenggara. Dalam bahasa inggris dikenal dengan nama Common puff-faced watersnake, banded watersnake, atau banded puff-faced watersnake.

Zyxomma petiolatum, known by the common names longtailed duskdarter, brown dusk hawk and dingy duskflyer, is a species of dragonfly in the family Libellulidae. It is widespread in many Asian countries, and north-eastern Australia.

species.name: Mandar-Padi Siantar
species.summary: The slaty-breasted rail (Gallirallus striatus) is a species of rail found in the Indian Subcontinent and Southeast Asia. Breeding has been recorded in July near Dehradun in the foothills of the Indian Himalayas.

species.name: Burung-Madu Bakau
species.summary: The copper-throated sunbird (Leptocoma calcostetha) is a species of bird in the Nectariniidae family. It is found in Brunei, Cambodia, Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, the Philippines, Thailand, and Vietnam. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical mangrove forests.

species.name: Kerakbasi Besar
species.summary: Kerak-basi besar (bahasa Latin: Acrocephalus orientalis) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Sylviidae, dari genus Acrocephalus. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan serangga keci dan memiliki habitat di rawa payau berbuluh, rawa sawah, mangrove.

species.name: Tikus rumah
species.summary: Tikus rumah (Rattus rattus) adalah hewan pengerat biasa yang mudah dijumpai di rumah-rumah dengan ekor yang panjang dan pandai memanjat serta melompat. Hewan ini termasuk dalam subsuku Murinae dan berasal dari Asia.

species.name: Takur Ampis
species.summary: The brown barbet (Caloramphus fuliginosus) is a species of bird in the family Megalaimidae. It is found in Borneo. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests.

species.name: Kangkok India
species.summary: Kangkok India (Cuculus micropterus) adalah bagian dari ordo burung yang berasal dari tekukur, kangkok, dan sejenisnya, yaitu Cuculiformes, yang ditemukan di Asia, dari Pakistan, Sri Lanka dan mengarah ke timur sampai ke Indonesia dan mengarah ke utara ke Tiongkok dan Rusia.

species.name: Jingjing Petulak
species.summary: The large woodshrike (Tephrodornis virgatus) is found in south-eastern Asia, Sumatra, Java, and Borneo. Its natural habitats are temperate forest, subtropical or tropical moist lowland forest, subtropical or tropical mangrove forest, and subtropical or tropical moist montane forest.

species.name: Brinji Kelabu
species.summary: The cinereous bulbul (Hemixos cinereus) is a species of songbird in the bulbul family, Pycnonotidae. It is found in Southeast Asia and Indonesia.

Argiocnemis rubescens is a species of damselfly in the family Coenagrionidae, commonly known as the red-tipped shadefly. It is a widespread species extending from India to southern China, south-east Asia, New Guinea and Australia.

The bigeye trevally, Caranx sexfasciatus (also known as the bigeye jack, great trevally, six-banded trevally and dusky jack), is a species of widespread large marine fish classified in the jack family Carangidae.

species.name: Gabus
species.summary: Channa striata, the striped snakehead, is a species of snakehead fish. It is also known as the common snakehead, chevron snakehead and snakehead murrel. It is native to South and Southeast Asia, and has been introduced to some Pacific Islands (reports from Madagascar and Hawaii are misidentifications of C. maculata).

species.name: Capung-jemur pesisir
species.summary: Macrodiplax cora, the coastal glider, also known as wandering pennant, and Cora’s pennant, is a species of dragonfly in the family Libellulidae.
Dischistodus melanotus, commonly known as the black-vent damsel, is a species of fish found in the western Pacific Ocean.

Hippocampus denise, atau yang juga dikenal sebagai kuda laut kerdil denise, adalah sebuah spesies kuda laut dari famili Syngnathidae yang berasal dari Pasifik barat. Spesies ini telah teramati di Indonesia, Vanuatu, Palau, Malaysia, Kepulauan Solomon, dan Mikronesia.

Hypolimnas misippus, the Danaid eggfly, mimic, or diadem, is a widespread species of nymphalid butterfly. It is well known for polymorphism and mimicry. Males are blackish with distinctive white spots that are fringed in blue.

Tropidolaemus wagleri is a venomous pitviper species native to South-East Asia. No subspecies are currently recognized. It is sometimes referred to as the temple viper because of its abundance around the Temple of the Azure Cloud in Malaysia.

Valenciennea puellaris, the Orange-spotted sleeper-goby, Orange-dashed goby, or Maiden goby,Diamond Watchman goby, is a species of goby native to the Indian Ocean and the western Pacific Ocean. It inhabits lagoons and outer reefs where it occurs on sandy substrates with larger pieces of rubble to burrow under.
Hipposideros cervinus adalah sebuah spesies kelelawar, dari genus Hipposideros.
The fimbriated moray (Gymnothorax fimbriatus) also known as darkspotted moray or spot-face moray is a moray eel of the family Muraenidae.

species.name: Pentis Kalimantan
species.summary: The yellow-rumped flowerpecker (Prionochilus xanthopygius) is a species of bird in the family Dicaeidae. It is found in Brunei, Indonesia, and Malaysia on the island of Borneo, to which it is endemic.

The boring clam, crocus clam, crocea clam or saffron-coloured clam (Tridacna crocea) is a species of bivalve in the family Cardiidae. It is native to the Indo-Pacific region. It is occasionally found in the aquarium trade where it is often simply referred to as crocea.

species.name: Kepudang-Sungu Sumatera
